output.reason: The changelog line [ev-2f28e1ec1c46] is vague by itself, but the linked PR description [ev-46a8d9760368] says what changed. It adds the static entrypoint setting `--entrypoints.<name>.asDefault`, which is the final name after the struck-through earlier names in [ev-989a69a51788]. By default every entrypoint stays a default entrypoint, as before. Only entrypoints marked `asDefault: true` change routing, and only for HTTP/TCP routes that set no entrypoints. That gives a new optional static-config key (static config files in [ev-fa5216d1eb09]) that only affects users who set it. Operators who do nothing see no change.
